verified_queries.name: store_sales_by_category_year
verified_queries.question: Store sales amount by item category for manager 1 in November 2000.
verified_queries.sql:
SELECT
  dt.d_year,
  item.i_category_id,
  item.i_category,
  sum(ss_ext_sales_price)
FROM czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.date_dim dt, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.store_sales, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.item
WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
  AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  AND item.i_manager_id = 1
  AND dt.d_moy = 11
  AND dt.d_year = 2000
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category
ORDER BY sum(ss_ext_sales_price) DESC, dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category
LIMIT 100

verified_queries.name: web_item_revenue_ratio
verified_queries.question: Web item revenue and class revenue ratio for Sports, Books and Home in a 30-day date window.
verified_queries.sql:
SELECT
  i_item_desc,
  i_category,
  i_class,
  i_current_price,
  sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue,
  sum(ws_ext_sales_price) * 100 / sum(sum(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.web_sales, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.item, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.date_dim
WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home')
  AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  AND d_date BETWEEN cast('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND (cast('1999-02-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL 30 days)
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio
LIMIT 100

verified_queries.name: inventory_before_after_window
verified_queries.question: Inventory before and after a reference date by warehouse and item for low-priced items.
verified_queries.sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT
    w_warehouse_name,
    i_item_id,
    sum(CASE WHEN (cast(d_date AS DATE) < cast('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand ELSE 0 END) AS inv_before,
    sum(CASE WHEN (cast(d_date AS DATE) >= cast('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand ELSE 0 END) AS inv_after
  FROM czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.inventory, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.warehouse, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.item, czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.date_dim
  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
    AND i_item_sk = inv_item_sk
    AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_date BETWEEN (cast('2000-03-11' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 30 days) AND (cast('2000-03-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL 30 days)
  GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id) x
WHERE (CASE WHEN inv_before > 0 THEN inv_after / inv_before ELSE NULL END) BETWEEN 2.0 / 3.0 AND 3.0 / 2.0
ORDER BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
